svg.aria-label: F169.1 flat's lines and inks: the architecture
svg.title: F169.1 flat's lines and inks: the architecture

g.text: F169.1 flat's lines and inks: the architecture
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: A theme's sheets set the values and the framework's sheets hold the rules that read them. The number in brackets is the step that changes the part. Every site forwards the framework's sheets, so a
rule fixed there is fixed on all of them.
